description: Read-only verbs for the World Music Atlas on Open Music Atlas: find places and their songs, list editions, get GeoJSON and embeddable players. No verb changes anything.

verbs.name: find_place
verbs.description: Find one place in the atlas by name, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or slug. Case- and accent-insensitive.

query.description: A place name ('Jamaica', 'cote d'ivoire'), ISO code ('JM') or slug ('jamaica').

place.description: The place: slug, name, isoCode, kind, continent, region, coordinates [lon, lat], isDisputed, pageUrl.

verbs.name: search_places
verbs.description: Places whose name contains the query, names starting with it first.

query.description: Part of a place name, e.g. 'guinea'.

verbs.name: list_places
verbs.description: List places in listening order, optionally narrowed to a UN M49 continent, region or kind.

kind.description: The kind of place. 'place' is used where classification is contested.

verbs.name: get_place_song
verbs.description: A place's song in an edition: its title, description, musical style, page and embeddable player.

place.description: The place's name, ISO code or slug.

edition.description: The edition's slug. Defaults to the 2026 Founding Edition ('2026-founding').
The edition: slug, name, year, version, frozenAt.

entry.description: The song: title, description, style, curatorsSelection, pageUrl, embedUrl.

verbs.name: get_embed_player
verbs.description: The embeddable player for a place's song: its URL and a ready-to-use iframe.

place.description: The place's name, ISO code or slug.

width.description: The frame's width, e.g. '100%' or '300'. Defaults to '100%'.

height.description: The frame's height. Defaults to '212', which fits the player.

verbs.name: list_editions
verbs.description: Every published edition of the World Music Atlas, newest first.

editions.description: Editions: slug, name, collection, year, version, styleConstraint, frozenAt, entryCount, pageUrl.

verbs.name: get_edition
verbs.description: An edition and every song in it, in listening order.

verbs.name: get_geojson
verbs.description: An edition as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection: one point per place, with the place and its song as properties.
